findings.summary: State and audit mutation paths existed outside the exclusive transition application service.
Every external request was not bound to a current fail-closed policy decision.
Confirmation consumption and submission idempotency were not authoritative and atomic.
Separate repository reads and writes left a race between expected-state and idempotency checks.
Audit metadata accepted free text that could contain PII or bearer-like values.
A generic retry path could assert SUBMITTED_API without a connector receipt.
